name: Polynomial Objective Disguise
description: Replaces the explicit "lexicographically smallest" tie-break rule with an equivalent mathematical objective function, P = sum(a_i * 4^{n-i}). Because a_i is bounded in {1, 2, 3}, this polynomial evaluated at base 4 is strictly monotonic with respect to lexicographical order, preserving the exact same unique minimum. However, models that fail to mathematically deduce this equivalence will attempt to evaluate all valid configurations (causing TLE on loose constraints) or overflow standard 64-bit integer types in languages like C++ when computing 4^40 (causing WA), rather than using the intended early-exit DFS.
